\begin{frame}{Ohm's law}
  \begin{theorem}[Ohm]
    The current through a resistor is $I = V/R$.
  \end{theorem}
  \begin{proof}
    Experiment shows $V \propto I$.
  \end{proof}
\end{frame}
\begin{frame}{Resistors in series}
  \begin{enumerate}
    \item The same current flows through each: $I_1 = I_2$.
    \item The voltages add: $V = V_1 + V_2$.
    \item So $R_\mathrm{eq} = R_1 + R_2$.
  \end{enumerate}
  \alert{Remember} to check units.
\end{frame}
